Name: Sunflower
Base Ability: Produces 50 sun every 24 seconds.
Plant Food Effect: Instantly produces 150 sun.

Name: Twin Sunflower
Base Ability: Produces 100 sun per cycle.
Plant Food Effect: Instantly produces 250 sun.

Name: Sun-shroom
Base Ability: Grows through 3 stages, producing more sun each time (25/50/75). To Stg2: 24s | To Stg3: 72s
Plant Food Effect: Instantly grows to full size and produces 225 sun.

Name: Primal Sunflower
Base Ability: Produces a large 75 sun from the very start.
Plant Food Effect: Instantly produces 225 sun.

Name: Gold Bloom
Base Ability: Instantly produces a large one-off burst of sun and then vanishes. (375 sun)
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Peashooter
Base Ability: Fires a single pea straight ahead.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a rapid burst of peas for a few seconds.

Name: Repeater
Base Ability: Fires 2 peas straight ahead per volley.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a heavy burst plus 1 giant pea (20x damage).

Name: Threepeater
Base Ability: Fires a pea in 3 parallel lanes at once.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a fan-shaped burst across every lane.

Name: Snow Pea
Base Ability: Fires a straight pea that chills and slows zombies.
Plant Food Effect: Freezes the lane and fires an icy burst.

Name: Rotobaga
Base Ability: Fires in 4 diagonal directions.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a burst in all 4 diagonal directions.

Name: Pea Pod
Base Ability: Fires one pea for every head stacked on top of it (up to 5 heads).
Plant Food Effect: Fires one giant pea per head (20x damage).

Name: Split Pea
Base Ability: Fires 1 pea forward and 2 peas backward.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a burst forward and backward at the same time.

Name: Citron
Base Ability: Fires a heavy straight shot (needs charge time).
Plant Food Effect: Fires a plasma ball that clears the whole lane.

Name: Caulipower
Base Ability: Fires a magic shot (random direction, passes obstacles, hypnotises its target).
Plant Food Effect: Hypnotises several random zombies on the lawn.

Name: Electric Blueberry
Base Ability: Fires a lightning bolt (random direction, destroys one zombie outright).
Plant Food Effect: Destroys 3 random zombies outright.

Name: Bowling Bulb
Base Ability: Fires 3 kinds of bulb that ricochet between lanes (like Wall-nut Bowling). Delay per bulb Cyan: 2s | Blue: 5s | Orange: 10s
Plant Food Effect: Fires 3 large explosive bulbs that ricochet.

Name: Cactus
Base Ability: Fires a straight spike that pierces through 3 zombies.
Plant Food Effect: Electric spikes with high damage and unlimited piercing.

Name: Fire Peashooter
Base Ability: Fires a straight flaming pea (double damage).
Plant Food Effect: Fires a flaming burst down the whole lane.

Name: Starfruit
Base Ability: Fires in 5 star-shaped directions, including backwards.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a star burst in every direction.

Name: Goo Peashooter
Base Ability: Fires a straight glob (ignores armour and deals damage over time).
Plant Food Effect: Fires a toxic burst that poisons zombies on the spot.

Name: Mega Gatling Pea
Base Ability: Fires 4 straight peas per volley at very high speed.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a huge sustained burst down the lane plus 4 giant peas.

Name: Sea-shroom
Base Ability: Fires a short-range shot. Limited lifespan of 60 seconds.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a burst and resets the lifespan of every Sea-shroom.

Name: Puff-shroom
Base Ability: Fires a short-range shot. Limited lifespan of 60 seconds.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a burst and resets the lifespan of every Puff-shroom.

Name: Fume-shroom
Base Ability: Fires medium-range fumes that pass straight through zombies.
Plant Food Effect: Releases a huge cloud of fumes that pushes zombies back.

Name: Cabbage-pult
Base Ability: Lobs its shot over obstacles.
Plant Food Effect: Lobs cabbages at several random zombies.

Name: Kernel-pult
Base Ability: Lobs a kernel (light damage) or butter (briefly stuns a zombie).
Plant Food Effect: Drops butter on the head of every zombie on the lawn.

Name: Melon-pult
Base Ability: Heavy lobbed shot with splash damage.
Plant Food Effect: Lobs giant melons at random zombies.

Name: Winter Melon
Base Ability: Heavy lobbed shot with splash damage that also chills zombies.
Plant Food Effect: Lobs frozen melons at random zombies.

Name: Pepper-pult
Base Ability: Lobbed shot with splash damage that also warms the surrounding tiles.
Plant Food Effect: Lobs large peppers at 3 random zombies.

Name: Potato Mine
Base Ability: Arms itself after a 15 second delay, then explodes on contact.
Plant Food Effect: Arms instantly and throws out 2 more mine clones.

Name: Primal Potato Mine
Base Ability: Arms faster, in 5 seconds, and explodes over a 3x3 area.
Plant Food Effect: Arms instantly and throws 2 mines to other tiles.

Name: Cherry Bomb
Base Ability: Explodes instantly over a 3x3 area.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Squash
Base Ability: Squashes the first zombie next to it.
Plant Food Effect: Squashes 2 random zombies on the lawn.

Name: Grapeshot
Base Ability: Explodes over a 3x3 area and scatters ricocheting grapes that vanish after 5 seconds.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Jalapeno
Base Ability: Instantly torches every zombie in one lane (and melts ice).
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Doom-shroom
Base Ability: Devastating blast across the whole lawn, leaving an unplantable crater.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Tangle Kelp
Base Ability: Drags the first waterborne zombie under and destroys it (Big Wave Beach only).
Plant Food Effect: Drags several random zombies in the water under the surface.

Name: Iceberg Lettuce
Base Ability: Freezes the first zombie that steps on it.
Plant Food Effect: Freezes every zombie currently on screen.

Name: Bonk Choy
Base Ability: Punches the tiles directly in front of and behind it.
Plant Food Effect: Punches wildly across the 3x3 area around itself.

Name: Phat Beet
Base Ability: Sonic pulse over the 3x3 area around it.
Plant Food Effect: A far more powerful sonic pulse hitting every nearby zombie.

Name: Chomper
Base Ability: Swallows a zombie whole, destroying it instantly, then chews for 40 seconds.
Plant Food Effect: Swallows 3 zombies at once from a distance.

Name: Wasabi Whip
Base Ability: Whips the tiles in front of and behind it (also warms the surroundings).
Plant Food Effect: Spins the whip across the 3x3 area.

Name: Kiwibeast
Base Ability: Area sonic wave that grows larger and hits harder over time. To Stg2: 24s | To Stg3: 72s
Plant Food Effect: Leaps up and slams the ground for area damage.

Name: Wall-nut
Base Ability: A tough barricade that holds zombies back.
Plant Food Effect: Gains permanent armour worth 4000 extra health.

Name: Tall-nut
Base Ability: A tall barricade; stops zombies from jumping over it.
Plant Food Effect: Gains permanent armour worth 8000 health.

Name: Endurian
Base Ability: A barricade that reflects damage back at the zombie biting it.
Plant Food Effect: Gains metal armour and increased reflected damage.

Name: Garlic
Base Ability: When eaten, forces the zombie to move to an adjacent lane.
Plant Food Effect: Forces every zombie in the lane into other lanes.

Name: Sweet Potato
Base Ability: A magnet that pulls zombies from adjacent lanes into its own lane.
Plant Food Effect: Pulls in every nearby zombie and fully restores its own health.

Name: Explode-o-nut
Base Ability: A barricade that explodes over an area the moment its health runs out.
Plant Food Effect: Gains metal armour (it also explodes when the armour is destroyed).

Name: Pumpkin
Base Ability: A protective shell; planted on top of other plants to shield them.
Plant Food Effect: Gains powerful metal armour.

Name: Sun Bean
Base Ability: Acts as a defensive wall and produces 5 sun with every hit it takes.
Plant Food Effect: Gains powerful metal armour.

Name: Torchwood
Base Ability: Changes shot properties; turns any pea passing through into a flaming one (double damage, melts ice).
Plant Food Effect: Creates a blue flame (triples the damage of passing shots).

Name: Magnet-shroom
Base Ability: Disarms zombies by pulling metal objects (buckets/helmets) off their heads.
Plant Food Effect: Pulls in several pieces of metal at once and digests them.

Name: Hypno-shroom
Base Ability: When eaten, the attacking zombie is hypnotised and fights for the player.
Plant Food Effect: Turns the zombie that eats it into an allied Gargantuar.

Name: Cat-tail
Base Ability: Fires a homing shot at the nearest zombie.
Plant Food Effect: Fires a rapid burst of homing shots.

Name: Imitater
Base Ability: Copies another plant (lets you use the same card twice).
Plant Food Effect: None (depends on the copied plant).

Name: Ice-shroom
Base Ability: Freezes and briefly stops every zombie on the whole lawn.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Lily Pad
Base Ability: A pad that lets other plants be planted on water (essential on the beach).
Plant Food Effect: Creates several copies of itself on empty water tiles.

Name: Hot Potato
Base Ability: Planted on ice to melt it instantly (essential in the Frostbite Caves).
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Name: Grave Buster
Base Ability: Destroys gravestones. (Essential in Ancient Egypt and the Dark Ages.)
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Base Ability: Temporarily applies Plant Food to every plant in its own family.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Base Ability: Temporarily applies Plant Food to every plant in its own family.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Base Ability: Temporarily applies Plant Food to every plant in its own family.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Base Ability: Temporarily applies Plant Food to every plant in its own family.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).

Base Ability: Temporarily applies Plant Food to every plant in its own family.
Plant Food Effect: None (single-use plant).
